title: Rabbi Marion
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Eruvin 19a: "Rabbi Marion said in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, and some say it: Rabbah bar Marion of the school of Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai"; and in Sukkah 32b: "Rabbi Marion said in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, and some say it: Rabbah bar Mari taught in the name of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai"; and Dikdukei Soferim reads: "And so it was taught in the school of Rabbi Marion in the name of Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai." And we find in Pesachim 103a: "Marta in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua"; and Dikdukei Soferim reads: "Maruna in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi." And it is possible that he is Rabbi Marion.

notes.text: Marion/Maruna/Marta and Rabbah bar Marion/bar Mari are retained as reported variants. The final identification is Hyman’s conjecture.

The consulted Eruvin 19a names Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai, while Sukkah 32b names him Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai. The title is rendered according to each occurrence. Pesachim 103a reads Marta in Rabbi Yehoshua’s name; the reported Maruna/Yehoshua ben Levi variant in Dikdukei Soferim remains Hyman’s report of an uninspected exact edition.
